desc: Constellation cloak spirit: floating violet hooded cloak with gold star studs and a small gold star crown. Face: hidden in the hood shadow, only two glowing gold slit eyes visible, no mouth. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
